title: A selection and cost sheet for the client
description: A designer’s working board with real products, prices and links. The selection turns into a cost sheet and a presentation, and the client marks the options they like.

blocks.text: A designer assembles a selection to discuss with a client. When the price, the link and the comment live apart from the image, replacing one item means edits in several places. A link between a decision and the numbers behind it is what helps here.

quote.text: I love this tool for creating interior design mood boards! The snipping tool is my favorite feature, allowing me to create cut sheets with pricing.

blocks.text: Keep an image, the product, the price and the approval state with every item. Build both the presentation and a draft cost sheet from one selection. After a substitution, show which approved lines changed, and keep the previous version available.

Take one real selection and run it through a client’s comments. Check whether the links, the notes and the total survive a substitution. The result will show which part of the approval process is genuinely worth keeping in one place.
